title: DigiEmu P0 Command Envelope v0.1
description: Command that has passed architectural Admission and is eligible for execution. Admission does not imply DigiEmu Core verification success and does not imply that runtime enforcement exists in Core 2.0.

schema_version.description: Version of the Command Envelope schema.

architecture_revision.description: Revision of the authoritative architecture baseline. This field references architecture-baseline.yaml: baseline.revision. The current authoritative revision is "0.3".

command_id.description: Unique identifier for this admitted command instance. The exact deterministic derivation rule for command_id is not yet defined; it MUST NOT be assumed to be random, UUID-generated, or produced by any non-deterministic process.

admission_ref.description: Reference to the Admission Result that admitted this command.

capability_ref.description: Reference to the capability being exercised, as defined in core-capability-registry.yaml.

aggregate_ref.description: Reference to the aggregate owner responsible for the target of the command, as defined in aggregate-ownership-registry.yaml.

command_ref.description: Reference to the architectural command, as defined in command-event-catalogue.yaml.

transition_ref.description: Reference to the defined transition that this command resolves to, as defined in command-event-catalogue.yaml.

payload.description: Admitted command-specific payload. The exact schema for each payload is not defined in this envelope; it is interpreted by the target command handler.
